# Links Guide

This page links to the SQL reference and to the Python API documentation so readers can follow the whole series of related guides without searching again.

* [SQL Window Functions](https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/sql-ref-window-functions.html)
* [Python API Reference](https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/api/python/index.html "Python API")
* [Window Clause Syntax](https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/sql-ref-syntax-qry-select-window.html)

Links carry descriptive anchor text that is preserved verbatim when the page is converted to Markdown for retrieval, so the destination URL and the label remain usable by downstream tooling.
